nodes.label: DesktopForge App Icon (org.jrf.DesktopForge.svg)
nodes.rationale: Blue (#62a0ea to #1c71d8) rounded-square app icon depicting a translucent desktop surface holding widget cards plus a launcher arrow; visually encodes the app's two halves: desktop widgets and desktop shortcuts. Icon name matches the app ID org.jrf.DesktopForge used for desktop-file packaging.

nodes.label: Widget Cards Motif (text card, clock card, wide bar card)
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'two widget cards sitting on it' (the desktop surface). Cards show text lines, a clock face, and a wide strip, representing the desktop widget feature.

nodes.label: Launcher Arrow Motif (shortcut half of the app)
nodes.rationale: Comment: 'launcher arrow, for the shortcut half of the app'. Diagonal arrow into a corner bracket represents creating/launching desktop shortcuts.
